Aromatic carbons count 11 though? But DBE 4 suggests only one aromatic ring (6 carbons). Why 11 aromatic carbons? Maybe they counted aromatic carbons as all carbons in aromatic system, maybe there is a phenyl plus a cyclohexadienyl? But DBE would be higher.
